text:
Maya: FYI vendor Sylphion filed a dispute on invoice V-8221. They claim we promised a temporary volume rebate for Q4 pilots (email thread attached). They want a one-time credit of $9,450. Can we process?

Owen: I see the sales note in the deal entry: 'pilot rebate: 15% off usage up to $63k, valid Oct-Nov'. That would make the rebate amount plausible, but we don't have Deal Desk approval recorded. Ticket SR-5019 has the attached email chain.

Carlos: Per policy, vendor-facing credits that affect revenue recognition over $7k require Finance lead + Sales Ops sign-off. This is $9,450 so need approvals. Also check ARR/contra account impact.

Maya: Sales Ops (Jamal) - can you confirm the rebate was committed by our AE and whether finance should treat as marketing contra-rev?

Jamal: Confirmed - AE documented agreement in email on 2025-10-05. Sales Ops recommends a one-time rebate to preserve partner. Classification: marketing contra-revenue. Approve from Sales Ops side pending Finance.

Carlos: OK. I provisionally approve the credit amount but need GL code and memo language. GL: 6505 (Promotional Credits). Please include 'one-time pilot rebate per AE commitment' in memo.

Maya: Drafting credit memo now. Calculation: invoice V-8221 amount = $63,000; rebate 15% = $9,450. SQL used:
```
SELECT invoice_id, total_amount, rebate_pct, total_amount * rebate_pct AS rebate
FROM vendor_invoices
WHERE invoice_id = 'V-8221';
```

Owen: Legal confirm no contract amendment needed since email trail is short-term pilot agreement. Legal gave thumbs up in thread.

Maya: BillingBot, please queue credit memo CM-2025-12-240 for vendor invoice V-8221 amount=9450 reason='15% pilot rebate (AE commitment)'. Tag: vendor_rebate.

BillingBot: queued credit memo CM-2025-12-240 (amount: $9,450) for V-8221. Processing ETA: 48h. Reference: #CM-2025-12-240.

Carlos: Record in Deal Desk: DD-V-2025-063 with link to SR-5019 and GL=6505. Jamal, confirm revenue impact entry and date for month-end close.

Jamal: Will book contra-revenue in December close under 6505. Noted.

Maya: Sent vendor-facing note: "We issued a one-time pilot rebate as previously agreed between our AE and Sylphion. This credit will appear on your next statement." Want to send now?

Owen: Send it after credit posts to avoid confusion.

BillingBot: CM-2025-12-240 posted to vendor account at 2025-12-03T09:12:41Z.

Maya: Confirmed posting. Notified vendor and closed SR-5019. Marking as one-off rebate; no contract change. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
